Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.text: Sunita says she wants to talk about painting her flat.
Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.quote: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.text: Ramesh asks which flat it is and how big it is.
Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.quote: Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.text: Sunita says the flat is a 2BHK in Sector 62, Noida, and the work is to do the ceilings of the two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathrooms.
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida; ceilings of two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathrooms
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.quote: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.text: Ramesh asks whether the job is only interior work or also balcony and exterior work.
Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.quote: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the work is only inside, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale paint.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.value: inside only; two coats; putty where needed; Asian Paints Royale paint
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.text: Ramesh says it will be the full 2BHK from inside, with two coats, putty, and Royale paint.
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.value: full 2BHK inside; two coats; putty; Royale paint
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.quote: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.text: Sunita says yes, that is exactly the work: inside-only painting of the 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale paint.
Sunita asks Ramesh how much he will charge.

Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.text: Ramesh says the total for material and labour will be 45,000 rupees.
Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.quote: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.text: Sunita says 40,000 rupees for the job instead of 45,000.
45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.quote: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.text: Ramesh says 42,000 rupees is the final price and it cannot be less.
Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.quote: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita accepts Ramesh's 42,000 rupees as the job amount.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita asks whether Ramesh will provide the material.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh says the material will be entirely his.
Ramesh says he needs some advance before starting the work to buy paint.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Kitna advance?.text: Sunita asks how much advance is needed.

15 hazaar de dijiye advance..text: Ramesh asks for 15,000 rupees as advance.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita says she will give 10,000 rupees as advance, by UPI tomorrow.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Ramesh accepts the 10,000 rupees advance Sunita proposed, to be sent tomorrow by UPI.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Ramesh says the advance should be sent tomorrow.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.text: Sunita asks when the remaining money should be paid.
Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.quote: Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: Ramesh says they will see about it and asks when the work should start.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..text: Sunita says the work should start from Monday, 23 November.
Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..quote: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: Ramesh says the work starts on Monday, 23 November 2026.
Ramesh says the work will finish by 30 November 2026.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: Sunita asks whether it is definitely by the 30th, and mentions that guests are coming to her home on 2 December.
Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.quote: Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.text: Ramesh accepts the finish date as 30 November 2026 and says the work will be complete by then.
Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.quote: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.text: Sunita asks whether everything has been noted down.
Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?.quote: Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: Ramesh says the total is 43,000 rupees.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: Ramesh says 10,000 rupees will be given as advance tomorrow.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.text: Sunita says the work also includes covering the furniture and cleaning.
Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.quote: Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: Worker Ramesh says they will cover everything and leave only after cleaning, accepting Sunita's added work terms about covering furniture and cleaning.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita accepts the 10,000 rupee advance and says she will send it tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita says she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon.

Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.text: Sunita says "Theek hai" at the start, accepting nothing new about the deal.
Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.quote: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.
